{{Top|leg}}
The '''under-palatine for patriotic liaisons''' was a position within the bureaucratic government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troxar]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The holder of this office conducted [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] for [[Gender/Legends|his or her]] planet. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Under-palatine for patriotic liaisons (Clone Wars)|holder]] of the title was simultaneously the [[first diplomatic legatee]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
